hero.subheadline: Artists worldwide submit work for Tel Aviv's 13th photography festival
hero.valueProposition: Selected artists receive exhibition space in the Main Exhibition, inclusion in the festival catalog, and website features at Tel Aviv's 13th International Photography Festival.

content.whyJoin:
PHOTO IS:RAEL's 13th International Photography Festival is an established photography platform in Tel Aviv, hosting over 200 Israeli and international photographers across a two-week exhibition period. Selected artists gain visibility through the Main Exhibition, the festival catalog, and the festival website, reaching thousands of visitors annually. The CITIZENS theme creates a meaningful context for civic engagement and social practice through the lens of photography.

The festival has been running since 2009, establishing itself as a recurring cultural institution in Tel Aviv's arts calendar. Unlike commercial competitions, this is a non-profit initiative focused on dialogue and research through photographic practice.

Artists working across still photography, film, video, performance documentation, animation, and digital or hybrid forms are eligible, making this an interdisciplinary opportunity for visual creators.
content.whoShouldApply: This open call is for photographers, filmmakers, video artists, animators, and digital/interactive artists at any career stage, from emerging practitioners to established professionals. It is suitable for individual artists and collaborative teams proposing existing works or new projects that explore civic engagement, social participation, visibility of marginalized communities, democratic resilience, or the transformation of personal experience into shared public knowledge. The festival explicitly welcomes submissions from artists worldwide, regardless of geographic origin, and does not restrict participation by age or prior publication history.
benefits: Exhibition of selected work in the Main Exhibition at the 13th International Photography Festival
Feature in the 2026 festival catalog distributed to attendees and international audiences
Website exposure on the PHOTO IS:RAEL platform reaching thousands of annual visitors
Opportunity to exhibit alongside over 200 Israeli and international photographers
tips: Submit up to 12 JPG images at 1920 pixels on the long side; each artist may submit only one application
For video or installation work, provide a direct viewing link in the project description and upload 6 related images
Each artist may submit only one application to the 2026 Open Call
The application fee is $22 USD. Applications open July 2 and close at midnight July 28, Israel time — plan accordingly for your time zone
Use the email subject line format: Open Call for the 13th Photography Festival Applicant Name when contacting info@photoisrael.org

shouldYouApply.idealFor: This contest is ideal for photographers, video artists, animators, and digital creators working with social themes who want exhibition exposure at a well-established international festival with a civic engagement focus. It suits artists who work with photography, film, video, or hybrid media and are comfortable submitting existing work or new project proposals in English or Hebrew.
goodFit: A photographer with existing work on civic engagement or community visibility looking for a curated exhibition opportunity
A filmmaker or video artist proposing a project that explores democratic participation or grassroots perspectives
An animator or digital artist creating work that addresses social themes and wants festival catalog exposure
An interdisciplinary artist working across media who wants a venue accepting photography, film, video, performance documentation, and hybrid forms
notIdealFor: An artist who only works in traditional painting or sculpture — these media are not listed as accepted formats
An applicant seeking a cash prize or monetary award — no cash prizes are specified in the official open call
Someone who needs a guaranteed acceptance — the festival is competitive and only selects work for the Main Exhibition

faq.question: What is the submission fee and what does it cover?
faq.answer: The application fee is $22 USD. The fee covers the registration and jurisdiction process and contributes to the presentation of artworks at the 2026 International Photography Festival. The payment is transferred to PHOTO IS:RAEL Ltd., a non-profit organization.

faq.question: Can artists submit more than once or submit multiple projects?
faq.answer: Each artist may apply to the 2026 Open Call only once. Each application should include the proposed work and up to 12 images depending on the nature of the project.

faq.question: What media formats are accepted for this open call?
faq.answer: Accepted formats include photography, film, video, performance documentation, animation, digital works, interactive works, and hybrid forms. For video or installation work, a direct viewing link must be included in the project description along with 6 uploaded images.

faq.question: When will selected artists be notified?
faq.answer: Artists whose work is selected for the Main Exhibition will be notified during August 2026.

faq.question: Where is the festival held and what is the theme?
faq.answer: The 13th International Photography Festival takes place in Tel Aviv in October 2026. The theme for this edition is CITIZENS, exploring civic engagement and democratic values through photography.

submissionGuide.detail: Gather up to 12 JPG images at 1920 pixels on the long side for still photography. For video or installation work, prepare a direct viewing link and upload 6 related images alongside your project description.
Describe the proposed or existing work, including how it relates to the CITIZENS theme. Include a direct viewing link for video works or live performance documentation within the description field.

submissionGuide.step: Submit via the official Open Call website
submissionGuide.detail: Go to https://opencall.photoisrael.org/ during the open call period, which runs from July 2 to July 28, 2026. Follow the application guidelines on the website.
Submit the $22 USD fee for registration and processing. The payment is non-refundable and goes toward the submission process and exhibition presentation.
Selected artists will be notified during August 2026. Results are communicated via the contact email provided in the application.
